question: 2 bags and 11 pens together cost ₹505, whereas 10 bags and 10 pens together cost ₹1310. The cost of 8 bags exceeds the cost of 8 pens by:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total cost: 10 **bags** + 10 **pens** = ₹1310 ⇒ 1 **bag** + 1 **pen** = ₹131.

Multiply by 2: 2 **bags** + 2 **pens** = ₹262.

Compare with first case: (2 **bags** + 11 **pens**) − (2 **bags** + 2 **pens**) = 505 − 262 ⇒ 9 **pens** = ₹243.

Cost of 1 **pen** = ₹27, and 1 **bag** = 131 − 27 = ₹104.

Difference for 8 units = 8 × (104 − 27) = 8 × 77 = ₹616.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹616.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

2B + 11P = 505 (Equation 1)

10B + 10P = 1310 (Equation 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e163e60e886a6ce8bbd938ad6d5a1242797682532e626eb766eca968fafe649.png] 

From Equation 2, simplify by dividing by 10:

⇒ B + P = 131 ⇒ B = 131 − P

Substitute B in Equation 1:

⇒ 2(131 − P) + 11P = 505

⇒ 262 − 2P + 11P = 505

⇒ 9P = 505 − 262

⇒ 9P = 243 ⇒ P = 27

Now, find the **cost** of the **bag**:

⇒ B = 131 − 27 = 104

Calculate the required **difference**:

⇒ 8B − 8P = 8(B − P)

⇒ 8(104 − 27) = 8 × 77

⇒ 8 × 77 = 616

**∴ The correct answer is ₹616.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equations in Two Variables

These are equations of the form ax + by = c. They can be solved using **elimination**, **substitution**, or **cross-multiplication** methods.

Cost Difference Logic

The difference of costs for multiple items n(B − P) is always n times the difference of single item costs (B − P).

Substitution Method

Express one variable in terms of the other from the simpler equation and substitute it into the complex one to reduce the system to a single variable.
